lines.text: Astra asks your own server for a film's direct TorBox address, so it plays in Astra's full player.
Add your TorBox key to your server once (a Worker secret) for the quickest route; without it, the add-on's link is used.
Stream info says where a film comes from, and why when Chrome's plain player is used.
Nothing is added to your TorBox before you tap a stream.
